prev_m1_guidance_text: These acts should be performed before entering Ihram, either at the place of Ihram or beforehand.
prev_m1_mighat_condition_item1: It is preferable to perform Ghusl for Ihram at the Miqat.
prev_m1_male_item2: Carry two Ihram cloths (Rida and Izar) and sandals that do not cover the top of the feet or the area around the ankles.
prev_m1_male_item3: Attention: Since travelling under shade after entering Ihram entails a Kaffarah, it is better to arrange the journey to the Miqat so that no travel under shade is required after entering Ihram.
ip1_title: Instructions at the Place of Ihram
ip1_general_item1: Ritual purity through Wudu or Ghusl is not a condition for Ihram; therefore, the Ihram of a person in the state of Janabah, menstruation, or postnatal bleeding is also valid.
ip1_mighat_condition_item1: However, if Ihram is entered from inside a mosque, the rulings related to mosques must be observed.
ip1_mighat_condition_item2: Since Ihram is entered from inside Masjid al-Shajarah, the relevant rulings of the mosque must be observed.
ip1_general_item2: Purity of the body and clothing is not required for entering Ihram; therefore, a person may enter Ihram by making the intention and reciting the Talbiyah even if their body or clothing is impure. However, after entering Ihram, the Ihram clothing must be pure.
ip1_mighat_condition_item3: You must be certain that you have reached the Miqat.
ip1_mighat_condition_item4: Entering Ihram before or after the Miqat is not valid.
ip2_recommend_female_item1: Perform Ghusl (women experiencing menstruation or postnatal bleeding may also perform Ghusl for Ihram)
ip2_ghusl_modal_dua_text: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَبِاللهِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لِي نُورًا وَطَهُورًا وَحِرْزًا وَأَمْنًا مِنْ كُلِّ خَوْفٍ، وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ وَسُقْمٍ. اَللّٰهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي وَطَهِّرْ لِي قَلْبِي، وَاشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي، وَأَجْرِ عَلَى لِسَانِي مَحَبَّتَكَ وَمِدْحَتَكَ وَالثَّنَاءَ عَلَيْكَ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ لِي إِلَّا بِكَ، وَقَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ قِوَامَ دِينِي التَّسْلِيمُ لِأَمْرِكَ، وَالِاتِّبَاعُ لِسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ.
ip2_ghusl_recommend_item1: If, after performing Ghusl and before putting on the Ihram clothing, a minor ritual impurity occurs, or the person eats something or wears something forbidden while in Ihram, it is not unlikely that eating or wearing such clothing does not invalidate the Ghusl; however, repeating the Ghusl is recommended.
ip2_ghusl_recommend_item2: If Ghusl for Ihram is performed during the day, it remains sufficient until the end of the night.
ip2_ghusl_recommend_item3: If Ghusl for Ihram is performed at night, it remains sufficient until the end of the following day.
ip2_obligatory_item2: Make the intention and recite the Talbiyah
ip2_clothing_male_item1:
Remove all sewn clothing and put on the two Ihram cloths:
The Rida and Izar.
ip2_clothing_female_item1: Women should use their regular clothing as their Ihram clothing.
ip2_clothing_sub_title: Supplication When Putting on the Ihram Clothing:
ip2_clothing_general_item1: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي رَزَقَنِي مَا أُوَارِي بِهِ عَوْرَتِي، وَأُؤَدِّي فِيهِ فَرْضِي، وَأَعْبُدُ فِيهِ رَبِّي، وَأَنْتَهِي فِيهِ إِلَى مَا أَمَرَنِي
ip2_clothing_general_item2: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي قَصَدْتُهُ فَبَلَّغَنِي، وَأَرَدْتُهُ فَأَعَانَنِي وَقَبِلَنِي وَلَمْ يَقْطَعْ بِي، وَوَجْهَهُ أَرَدْتُ فَسَلَّمَنِي، فَهُوَ حِصْنِي وَكَهْفِي وَحِرْزِي، وَظَهْرِي وَمَلَاذِي، وَرَجَائِي وَمَنْجَايَ وَذُخْرِي وَعُدَّتِي فِي شِدَّتِي وَرَخَائِي.
ip6_male_not_janabah_label: Not in the state of Janabah
ip7_text_item1: It is recommended to enter Ihram after performing the Dhuhr prayer. If this is not possible, enter Ihram after any obligatory prayer. If that is also not possible, enter Ihram after performing six or two Rak‘ahs of a recommended prayer.
ip7_prayer_perform_title: How to Perform the Recommended Prayer:
ip7_prayer_perform_text:
Intention:
I perform the Ihram prayer for my own / a proxy Umrah al-Mufradah, seeking nearness to Allah.
ip7_text_item2: It is recommended to recite Surah al-Fatihah and Surah al-Ikhlas in the first Rak‘ah, and Surah al-Fatihah and Surah al-Kafirun in the second Rak‘ah.
ip7_text_item3: After the prayer, say “Alhamdulillah,” praise Allah, and then recite Salawat.
ip10_q1: Do you have access to water for performing Ghusl?
ip10_q2: Can you enter Ihram while passing through a mosque, entering through one door and leaving through another?
ip10_q3: Can you wait until you have access to water?
ip10_text_item1: Wait until you have access to water, perform Ghusl, and enter Ihram inside the mosque.
ip10_text_item2: When it is time to enter the mosque, perform Tayammum, enter the mosque, and enter Ihram.
ip10_q2_hint: Enter Ihram while passing through the mosque in this manner.
ip8_text_item1: It is recommended to state the intention verbally while reciting the Talbiyah.
ip8_text_item2: “I enter Ihram for Umrah al-Mufradah / Hajj al-Tamattu‘, seeking nearness to Allah.”
ip8_text_item3: Talbiyah: Reciting the Talbiyah is obligatory, and repeating it is recommended. If you are unable to recite it for any reason, use an audio recording and repeat after it.
ip8_talbiyah_text1: لَبَّیكَ الّلهُمَّ لَبَّیكَ، لَبَّیكَ لاشَریكَ لَكَ لَبَّیكَ
ip8_talbiyah_text2: إنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَ النِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلكَ، لاشَریكَ لَكَ لَبَّیكَ
ip8_talbiyah_text3:
لَبَّيْكَ ذَا الْمَعَارِجِ لَبَّيْكَ 
لَبَّيْكَ دَاعِياً إِلَى دَارِ السَّلَامِ لَبَّيْكَ 
لَبَّيْكَ غَفَّارَ الذُّنُوبِ لَبَّيْكَ 
لَبَّيْكَ أَهْلَ التَّلْبِيَةِ لَبَّيْكَ 
لَبَّيْكَ ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ لَبَّيْكَ 
لَبَّيْكَ تُبْدِئُ وَ الْمَعَادُ إِلَيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ 
لَبَّيْكَ تَسْتَغْنِي وَ يُفْتَقَرُ إِلَيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ 
لَبَّيْكَ مَرْهُوباً وَ مَرْغُوباً إِلَيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ 
لَبَّيْكَ إِلَهَ الْحَقِّ لَبَّيْكَ 
لَبَّيْك‌ ذَا النَّعْمَاءِ وَ الْفَضْلِ الْحَسَنِ الْجَمِيلِ لَبَّيْكَ 
لَبَّيْكَ كَشَّافَ الْكُرَبِ الْعِظَامِ لَبَّيْكَ 
لَبَّيْكَ عَبْدُكَ وَ ابْنُ عَبْدَيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ 
لَبَّيْكَ يَا كَرِيمُ لَبَّيْكَ
ip8_location_title: Place for the Intention and the Talbiyah:
ip8_location_adna_alhal: Anywhere Within Adna al-Hill (for example, Hudaybiyah, Ji‘ranah, or Tan‘im)
ip11_title:
You are now in the state of Ihram.
And it is obligatory for you to avoid everything prohibited during Ihram.
ip11_note_item1: If the Ihram clothing becomes impure, as an obligatory precaution, purify or replace it as soon as possible.
ip11_note_item2:
A person suffering from the continuous discharge of urine, wind, or stool (Mabtun), which causes the body or clothing to become impure, should prevent the impurity from spreading to the body and clothing whenever possible, such as by using a bag or similar device.
It is not obligatory to replace the bag repeatedly. However, as an obligatory precaution, the affected part of the body should be purified before each Tawaf whenever possible.
In all the above cases, purification must also be performed between Tawaf and the Tawaf prayer, unless there is no opportunity at all, or the available time is too short to perform purification and complete the Tawaf. Otherwise, Tawaf without ritual purity is not valid.
ip12_ihram_recommended_item1: Repeat the Talbiyah in the following situations:
ip12_ihram_recommended_sub_item3: Whenever boarding or getting off a mount or vehicle
ip12_ihram_recommended_sub_item4: When ascending or descending from a high place
ip13_ihram_disliked_item1: Sleeping on yellow-coloured bedding or a yellow pillow
ip13_ihram_disliked_item2: Entering a bathhouse; moreover, it is better—and, based on obligatory precaution, necessary—not to rub the body while bathing.
ip13_ihram_disliked_item3: Responding with “Labbayk” when someone calls; as a precaution, it is better to refrain from doing so.
